_comment: portal-config.json is TOKEN-FREE. Gateway tokens + the bootstrap admin password live in portal-secrets.json (0600). Network/TLS: bind defaults to 127.0.0.1 (loopback); exposing a non-loopback interface needs publicBind:true (or PORTAL_PUBLIC_BIND=1 / --public-bind) AND TLS (plan items 5 + 7) — see deploy/Caddyfile and deploy/nginx/cirrus-portal.conf.
